Zend Development in a Nutshell

Zend is one of the oldest and PHP frameworks that uses an open-source BSD-style license and is still in high demand. This makes it unrestrictive to use, modify, and repackage the framework code. It was launched in 2006 by the Zend Technologies company. With Zend certain web applications become stunningly simple to create when Zend programmer uses this framework. In short, you should hire PHP Zend developer, if you are looking for the following combination:

  • MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture
  • Simplicity combined with reusability
  • The ability to reuse existing open-source web app components
  • Loosely-coupled software that relies on configuration rather than convention.

By this time, being a package of professional PHP packages, Zend Framework got more than 345 million installations. This technology is used by a Zend programmer for a wide range of projects from web applications to fully independent services based on PHP 5.6+ with object-oriented code with a great number of language options available. If you are interested in technical aspects and workflow of Zend framework, take a look at the following mentioned by Project Lead of the company Matthew Weier O’Phinney:

  • Applies Composer as a package utility
  • PHPUnit checks all packages
  • Integrates through Travis CI
  • Operates according to PHP-FIG standards
  • Supports PSR-7 interfaces for HTTP messages.

It is worth noting that the technology is provided by Zend that is owned by a Rogue Wave Company, but a number of developed components and added features were created with a help of support of Zend developers community and contributors. Zend technology is known for one of the most supportive and responsive programming community that cooperates on forums, IRC channels, and even group chats. Such famous companies like Google, Microsoft, and Sound Strategies PR use Zend development for building web interfaces and applications and nowadays, there are 12,348 companies in total referring to Zend software development.

When you hire PHP Zend developer, you can greatly improve your PHP projects by developing high-quality web applications faster. In the absence of Zend, your Zend development team might struggle on settling on a proven and tested development standard. Zend framework proved to be an all-in-one solution for PHP-based projects. When exploring Zend Framework development, businesses can benefit from understanding how to hire programmers, building an optimal mobile app development team structure, and leveraging the benefits of an offshore development model, ultimately leading to the creation of high-quality and cost-effective applications that meet their specific requirements.

The Latest Zend Framework Updates

According to Zend Framework blog, the latest release of Expressive 3 was launched on March 16, 2018. On the date of this release, it was informed that Expressive 3 requires at least PHP 7.1. A few months later, Zend developers launched Expressive 3 complete version that can support all components of PHP 7.2 and connect to Apigilty modules. Now, the company works on finalizing and updating existing API-related modules for Expressive 3 version and plans to complete this task in the nearest months.

The base package was changed a lot: now if operated coordinating actions only, while a greater part of the code itself was put in a semantic affiliation or moved to a newly created packages. The base package is responsible for a user-friendly interface that helps to build application routes and pipelines. It worth noting that command-line tools were improved as well as allowing a Zend programmer to use the features in a simpler way. The updated creating request handlers and template support were reconsidered based on Zend programmer feedback. In Expressive 3, developers added a bunch of new features, also accessible by any PSR-15 framework besides Zend, including:

  • Zend-expressive-session that allows to abstract session and middleware and a single adapter zend-expressive-session-ext that uses PHP’s session extension;
  • Zend-expressive-flash allows flash using through PHP session;
  • Zend-expressive-CSRF refers to Cross-Site Request Forgery shield;
  • Zend-problem-details send responses for customer’s APIs, in both JSON and XML formats.

It can be clearly seen that the latest, third version of Zend framework was updated and extended based on requests and suggestions of Zend developers community. This way, the framework became more powerful and useful in terms of a variety of features and possibilities. No wonder that the number of companies who hire Zend framework developer is increasing each year accordingly.

  • Open Ticket – A support and ticketing package
  • Humhub – Social networking platform
  • Shopware – A software solution for e-commerce
  • Flarum Core – Open source forum software

Despite the fact that Zend programmer salary in New York is higher than in Illinois or Texas, the range is not that big.
